def all_keys(obj, prefix=""):
    out = []
    if isinstance(obj, dict):

            out.append(prefix + k)
            out.extend(all_keys(v, prefix + k + "."))
    elif isinstance(obj, list):

    # 09e: note below the table/cards visible, link correct, placed below

        "    const ref = document.querySelector(mobile ? '#sessions-cards' : '.sessions-table-wrap');"

        "  };"
        "  return {text: n.innerText, visible: r.width > 0 && r.height > 0,"
        "          top: Math.round(r.top), below_table: above(false), below_cards: above(true),"
        "          href: a ? a.href : null, target: a ? a.target : null};"
        "}")
    rep["sessions_note"] = note
    if note.get("missing"):
        fail(f"{label}: .sessions-note element missing")
    else:
        if not note["visible"]:
            fail(f"{label}: sessions note not visible")
        if note["text"] != "用量以 Qoder 账户用量页为准（账号 UID 见 dev-records/README.md）。":
            fail(f"{label}: sessions note text mismatch: {note['text']!r}")
        if note["href"] != NOTE_LINK:
            fail(f"{label}: sessions note link {note['href']!r} != {NOTE_LINK!r}")
        if note["target"] != "_blank":
            fail(f"{label}: sessions note link target={note['target']!r}")
        ref_key = "below_cards" if mobile else "below_table"
        if note[ref_key] is None or note[ref_key] < 0:
            fail(f"{label}: sessions note not below the {ref_key} element ({note[ref_key]})")

    # 09b: no horizontal overflow
    rep["scrollWidth"] = page.evaluate(
        "() => [document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.clientWidth]")
    rep["scrollWidth_overflow"] = rep["scrollWidth"][0] - rep["scrollWidth"][1]
    if rep["scrollWidth_overflow"] > 0:
        fail(f"{label}: scrollWidth exceeds viewport by {rep['scrollWidth_overflow']}px")

    # 09b: radar svg labels inside container
    rep["radar_labels"] = page.evaluate(
        "() => {"
        "  const cont = document.getElementById('radar-chart');"
        "  if (!cont) return {error: 'no container'};"
        "  const cr = cont.getBoundingClientRect();"
        "  const bad = [];"
        "  cont.querySelectorAll('svg text').forEach(t => {"
        "    const r = t.getBoundingClientRect();"
        "    if (r.width === 0 && r.height === 0) return;"
        "    if (r.left < cr.left - 1 || r.right > cr.right + 1 || r.top < cr.top - 1 || r.bottom > cr.bottom + 1)"
        "      bad.push({text: t.textContent.slice(0, 30),"
        "                left: Math.round(r.left - cr.left), right: Math.round(cr.right - r.right),"
        "                top: Math.round(r.top - cr.top), bottom: Math.round(cr.bottom - r.top)});"
        "  });"
        "  return {count: cont.querySelectorAll('svg text').length, out_of_bounds: bad};"
        "}")
    if rep["radar_labels"].get("out_of_bounds"):
        fail(f"{label}: radar labels out of bounds: {rep['radar_labels']['out_of_bounds']}")

    # sessions: backticks rendered as <code>, no raw backtick anywhere in page text
    rep["backticks"] = page.evaluate(
        "() => {"
        "  const text = document.body.innerText;"
        "  const codes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("
        "    'table.sessions td.title-cell code, .session-card .sc-title code'))"
        "    .map(c => c.textContent);"
        "  return {raw_backticks: (text.match(/`/g) || []).length, code_count: codes.length,"
        "           code_samples: codes.slice(0, 6)};"
        "}")
    if rep["backticks"]["raw_backticks"]:
        fail(f"{label}: raw backticks visible in page text: {rep['backticks']['raw_backticks']}")
    expected_code = [r["title"] for r in SESSIONS["rows"] if "`" in (r.get("title") or "")]
    if rep["backticks"]["code_count"] < len(expected_code):
        fail(f"{label}: expected >= {len(expected_code)} code elements, got {rep['backticks']['code_count']}")

    # 09e: session totals — rows/turns match the JSON, no credits in the JSON
    tot = SESSIONS["totals"]
    if mobile:
        total_text = page.locator(".sessions-cards .session-total").inner_text()
        rep["sessions_totals_text"] = total_text
        for needle in (str(tot["rows"]), str(tot["turns"])):
            if needle not in total_text:
                fail(f"{label}: session total text missing {needle!r}: {total_text}")
        # every session is a card; title width >= 280px; no clipped numbers
        cards = page.evaluate(
            "() => {"
            "  const out = {cards: document.querySelectorAll('.session-card').length, narrow: [], clipped: []};"
            "  document.querySelectorAll('.session-card').forEach(c => {"
            "    const t = c.querySelector('.sc-title');"
            "    if (t.clientWidth < 280) out.narrow.push(t.textContent.slice(0, 20));"
            "    if (c.scrollWidth > c.clientWidth) out.clipped.push({text: t.textContent.slice(0, 20),"
            "      sw: c.scrollWidth, cw: c.clientWidth});"
            "    c.querySelectorAll('.sc-stats b, .sc-head .sc-id, .sc-head .model-tag')"
            "     .forEach(el => { if (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth)"
            "       out.clipped.push({text: el.textContent, sw: el.scrollWidth, cw: el.clientWidth}); });"
            "  });"
            "  return out;"
            "}")
        rep["sessions_cards"] = cards
        if cards["cards"] != len(SESSIONS["rows"]):
            fail(f"{label}: session cards {cards['cards']} != rows {len(SESSIONS['rows'])}")
        if cards["narrow"]:
            fail(f"{label}: session card titles narrower than 280px: {cards['narrow']}")
        if cards["clipped"]:
            fail(f"{label}: session cards clipped: {cards['clipped']}")
        # 09e: each card shows exactly 2 stats (turns, duration) — no Credits card
        card_stats = page.evaluate(
            "() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.session-card .sc-stats'))"
            ".map(s => ({stats: s.querySelectorAll(':scope > div').length,"
            "            credits: /Credits/i.test(s.innerText)}))")
        rep["card_stats_samples"] = card_stats[:3]
        bad_stats = [s for s in card_stats if s["credits"] or s["stats"] != 2]
        if bad_stats:
            fail(f"{label}: session card stats unexpected: {bad_stats}")
        table_display = page.evaluate(
            "() => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.sessions-table-wrap')).display")
        rep["sessions_table_display"] = table_display
        if table_display != "none":
            fail(f"{label}: sessions table should be hidden on mobile, display={table_display}")
    else:
        rep["sessions_totals"] = {
            "rows": page.locator("#total-rows").inner_text(),
            "turns": page.locator("#total-turns").inner_text(),
        }
        if rep["sessions_totals"]["rows"] != str(tot["rows"]):
            fail(f"{label}: total rows mismatch")
        if rep["sessions_totals"]["turns"] != str(tot["turns"]):
            fail(f"{label}: total turns mismatch")

        # 09e: total row must span exactly 5 columns (td count or colspan sum)
        cols = page.evaluate(
            "() => {"
            "  const heads = document.querySelectorAll('table.sessions thead th').length;"
            "  const body = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#sessions-body tr'))"
            "    .map(tr => tr.querySelectorAll('td').length);"
            "  const footTds = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#sessions-total td'));"
            "  const foot = footTds.reduce((n, td) => n + (parseInt(td.colSpan) || 1), 0);"
            "  const bad_rows = body.filter(n => n !== 5).length;"
            "  return {header: heads, foot, body_rows: body.length, bad_rows,"
            "          header_text: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("
            "            'table.sessions thead th')).map(e => e.innerText).join('|')};"
            "}")
        rep["sessions_columns"] = cols
        if cols["header"] != 5:
            fail(f"{label}: session table header has {cols['header']} columns, expected 5")
        if cols["foot"] != 5:
            fail(f"{label}: total row spans {cols['foot']} columns, expected 5")
        if cols["bad_rows"]:
            fail(f"{label}: {cols['bad_rows']} session rows are not 5 columns")
        if cols["body_rows"] != len(SESSIONS["rows"]):
            fail(f"{label}: session rows {cols['body_rows']} != {len(SESSIONS['rows'])}")

        # every column except the title must be single-line (measure text via Range)
        cells = page.evaluate(
            "() => {"
            "  const tall = []; let rows = 0;"
            "  document.querySelectorAll('#sessions-body tr').forEach(tr => {"
            "    rows++; const tds = tr.querySelectorAll('td');"
            "    [tds[0], tds[2], tds[3], tds[4]].forEach(td => {"
            "      const range = document.createRange();"
            "      range.selectNodeContents(td);"
            "      const h = range.getBoundingClientRect().height;"
            "      if (h > 24) tall.push({text: td.textContent.slice(0, 20), h: Math.round(h)});"
            "    });"
            "  });"
            "  return {rows, tall};"
            "}")
        rep["session_cells"] = cells
        if cells["rows"] != len(SESSIONS["rows"]):
            fail(f"{label}: session rows {cells['rows']} != {len(SESSIONS['rows'])}")
        if cells["tall"]:
            fail(f"{label}: multi-line non-title session cells: {cells['tall']}")

        # title column width >= 45% of table width
        widths = page.evaluate(
            "() => {"
            "  const table = document.querySelector('table.sessions');"
            "  const tw = table.getBoundingClientRect().width;"
            "  const th = table.querySelectorAll('thead th')[1];"
            "  const title_w = th.getBoundingClientRect().width;"
            "  const body_td = document.querySelector('#sessions-body tr td.title-cell');"
            "  return {table: Math.round(tw), title: Math.round(title_w),"
            "           pct: title_w / tw,"
            "           title_cell: body_td ? Math.round(body_td.getBoundingClientRect().width) : null};"
            "}")
        rep["sessions_title_width"] = widths
        if widths["pct"] < 0.45:
            fail(f"{label}: title column {widths['pct']:.2%} < 45% of table")

    # blind list top row matches the JSON (sorted by blind_spot_score desc, tie by topic_id)
    items = sorted(COVERAGE["items"],
                   key=lambda i: (-(i.get("blind_spot_score") if i.get("blind_spot_score") is not None else -1),
                                  i.get("topic_id") or ""))
    rep["blind_expected_top_id"] = items[0]["topic_id"]
    if mobile:
        heads = page.locator(".blind-card .bc-head")
        detail_loc = page.locator(".bc-detail:not([hidden])").first
        body_text = page.locator("#blind-cards").inner_text()
        cards_n = page.locator(".blind-card").count()
        rep["blind_cards"] = cards_n
        if cards_n != len(COVERAGE["items"]):
            fail(f"{label}: blind cards {cards_n} != {len(COVERAGE['items'])}")
    else:
        heads = page.locator("tr.row-main")
        detail_loc = page.locator("tr.row-detail:not([hidden])").first
        body_text = page.locator("#blind-tbody").inner_text()
    head = heads.first
    head.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(250)
    rep["blind_top_row_text"] = head.inner_text()
    if items[0]["topic_name"] not in rep["blind_top_row_text"]:
        fail(f"{label}: top blind row is not {items[0]['topic_name']!r}: {rep['blind_top_row_text']}")
    detail = detail_loc.inner_text()
    rep["blind_top_detail_has"] = {
        "reason": bool(items[0].get("reason")) and items[0]["reason"][:20] in detail,
        "question": any(f"第 {q['question_no']} 题" in detail for q in items[0].get("exam_questions") or []),
    }
    if not rep["blind_top_detail_has"]["reason"]:
        fail(f"{label}: top blind detail missing reason")
    if not rep["blind_top_detail_has"]["question"]:
        fail(f"{label}: top blind detail missing questions")

    # every row in sorted order: name, level, coverage, weight, blind score, and
    # the reason (expanded) must match the JSON verbatim
    level_map = {"covered": "已覆盖", "thin": "薄弱", "missing": "缺失"}

    def js_num(v):
        # JS String(number): 25.0 -> "25", 2.5 -> "2.5"
        v = float(v)
        return str(int(v)) if v == int(v) else str(v)

    row_mismatch = []
    head.click()  # collapse the top row again
    page.wait_for_timeout(150)
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        h = heads.nth(i)
        row_text = (page.locator(".blind-card").nth(i).inner_text() if mobile
                    else h.inner_text())
        problems = []
        if it["topic_name"] not in row_text:
            problems.append("name")
        if level_map.get(it["coverage_level"]) not in row_text:
            problems.append("level")
        if it.get("coverage_score") is not None:
            cov_str = "%.4f" % it["coverage_score"]
            if cov_str not in row_text:
                problems.append("coverage:" + cov_str)
        if it.get("exam_weight") is not None and js_num(it["exam_weight"]) not in row_text:
            problems.append("weight:" + js_num(it["exam_weight"]))
        if it.get("blind_spot_score") is not None:
            blind_str = "%.2f" % it["blind_spot_score"]
            if blind_str not in row_text:
                problems.append("blind:" + blind_str)
        h.click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(120)
        det = detail_loc.inner_text()
        if it.get("reason") and it["reason"] not in det:
            problems.append("reason")
        h.click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(120)
        if problems:
            row_mismatch.append({"topic_id": it["topic_id"], "problems": problems})
    rep["blind_rows_verbatim"] = {"checked": len(items), "mismatch": row_mismatch}
    if row_mismatch:
        fail(f"{label}: blind rows not verbatim vs JSON: {row_mismatch}")

    missing = [it["topic_id"] for it in items if it["topic_name"] not in body_text]
    rep["all_topics_present"] = not missing
    if missing:
        fail(f"{label}: topics missing from list: {missing}")

    REPORT[label] = rep


def main() -> int:
    # 09e: no credits key anywhere in the generated JSON
    keys = all_keys(SESSIONS)
    bad_keys = [k for k in keys if "credits" in k.lower()]
    REPORT["json_keys"] = {"total": len(keys), "bad": bad_keys,
                           "row_keys": sorted(set(all_keys(SESSIONS["rows"][0]))) if SESSIONS["rows"] else [],
                           "totals_keys": sorted(SESSIONS["totals"].keys())}
    if bad_keys:
        fail(f"qoder-sessions.json still has credits keys: {bad_keys}")

    requests = []
    console_errors = []

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(channel="chrome", headless=True)

        for label, w, h, mobile in [("desktop_1440", 1440, 900, False), ("mobile_375", 375, 812, True)]:
            page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": w, "height": h})
            page.on("request", lambda r: requests.append(r.url))
            page.on("console", lambda m: console_errors.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)
            page.on("pageerror", lambda e: console_errors.append(str(e)))
            page.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
            page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
            check_page(page, label, mobile)

            # echarts.version must match the footer string
            ver = page.evaluate("() => (typeof echarts !== 'undefined') ? echarts.version : 'missing'")
            footer = page.evaluate(
                "() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('footer p'))"
                ".map(e => e.textContent).filter(t => t.indexOf('ECharts') >= 0).join('|')")
            REPORT[label]["echarts"] = {"version": ver, "footer": footer}
            m = footer and ver in footer
            if not m:
                fail(f"{label}: echarts.version {ver!r} not matching footer {footer!r}")

            # cmd-links: gap between README and 和 must be plain text spacing (<= 8px)
            gap = page.evaluate(
                "() => {"
                "  const a = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('p.cmd-links a'))"
                "    .find(x => x.textContent === 'README');"
                "  if (!a) return null;"
                "  const r = a.getBoundingClientRect();"
                "  const range = document.createRange();"
                "  const p = a.closest('p');"
                "  const idx = Array.from(p.childNodes).indexOf(a.nextSibling);"
                "  const next = a.nextSibling;"
                "  if (!next || next.nodeType !== 3) return null;"
                "  const hePos = next.textContent.indexOf('和');"
                "  if (hePos < 0) return null;"
                "  range.setStart(next, hePos); range.setEnd(next, hePos + 1);"
                "  const hr = range.getBoundingClientRect();"
                "  return Math.round(hr.left - r.right);"
                "}")
            REPORT[label]["cmdlinks_gap"] = gap
            if gap is None:
                fail(f"{label}: could not measure README-和 gap")
            elif gap > 8:
                fail(f"{label}: README-和 gap {gap}px > 8px")

            if label == "desktop_1440":
                page.screenshot(path=str(SCRATCH / "site-09e-desktop.png"), full_page=True)
            else:
                page.screenshot(path=str(SCRATCH / "site-09e-mobile.png"), full_page=True)
            page.close()

        # ---- video: default (file really present since 09d) ----
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        page.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        disp = page.evaluate("() => getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('demo-video')).display")
        pend_visible = page.locator("#video-pending").is_visible()
        REPORT["video_present"] = {"display": disp, "placeholder_visible": pend_visible}
        if disp == "none" or pend_visible:
            fail(f"video present: display={disp}, placeholder visible={pend_visible}")
        page.close()

        # ---- video: mocked missing (placeholder fallback) ----
        page2 = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        page2.route("**/media/demo.mp4", lambda r: r.abort())
        page2.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
        page2.wait_for_timeout(800)
        disp2 = page2.evaluate("() => getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('demo-video')).display")
        pend2 = page2.locator("#video-pending").is_visible()
        REPORT["video_missing"] = {"display": disp2, "placeholder_visible": pend2}
        if disp2 != "none" or not pend2:
            fail(f"video missing: display={disp2}, placeholder visible={pend2}")
        page2.close()

        # ---- usage variants ----
        variants = {
            "only_site_stats": {"status": "ok", "site_stats": {"pv": 321, "uv": 88, "period": "10-29 至 11-10", "source": "Qoder Sites 访问统计"}},
            "only_usage": {"status": "ok", "usage": {"usage_days": 9, "study_sessions": 14, "questions_answered": 60, "total_minutes": 240, "source": "使用记录导出"}},
            "only_feedback": {"status": "ok", "feedback": [{"quote": "雷达指出的盲区和真实情况对得上。", "source": "用户反馈"}]},
        }
        for name, payload in variants.items():
            pg = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
            body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
            def serve_usage(route, _request, b=body):
                route.fulfill(status=200, content_type="application/json", body=b)
            pg.route("**/data/usage-summary.json", serve_usage)
            pg.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
            pg.wait_for_timeout(800)
            blocks = pg.evaluate(
                "() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#usage-blocks .usage-block h3')).map(e => e.textContent)")
            collecting_visible = pg.locator("#usage-collecting").is_visible()
            REPORT[f"usage_{name}"] = {"blocks": blocks, "collecting_visible": collecting_visible}
            expected = {"only_site_stats": "Qoder Sites 访问统计", "only_usage": "使用记录汇总",
                        "only_feedback": "用户反馈"}[name]
            if len(blocks) != 1 or not blocks[0].startswith(expected):
                fail(f"usage {name}: blocks={blocks}, expected ['{expected}…']")
            if collecting_visible:
                fail(f"usage {name}: collecting card still visible")
            pg.close()

        # ---- real file (collecting) ----
        page3 = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        page3.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
        page3.wait_for_timeout(800)
        n_stats = page3.locator("#usage-filled .stat").count()
        collecting = page3.locator("#usage-collecting").is_visible()
        filled_hidden = page3.locator("#usage-filled").is_hidden()
        REPORT["usage_real"] = {"stat_count": n_stats, "collecting_visible": collecting,
                                "filled_hidden": filled_hidden, "file": USAGE_REAL}
        if n_stats or not collecting or not filled_hidden:
            fail(f"usage real file shows numbers: stats={n_stats}, collecting={collecting}")
        page3.close()

        browser.close()

    external = [u for u in requests if not u.startswith(BASE) and not u.startswith("data:")]
    real_errors = [e for e in console_errors if "404" not in e]
    REPORT["network"] = {"requests_total": len(requests), "external": external,
                         "console_errors": console_errors}
    if external:
        fail(f"external requests: {external}")
    if real_errors:
        fail(f"console errors beyond expected 404s: {real_errors}")

    print(json.dumps(REPORT, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    print("\n".join("FAILED: " + f for f in FAILED) if FAILED else "ALL 09e CHECKS PASSED")
    return 1 if FAILED else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
